summary: First engineering hire; joined the day the technical team was formed and grew with it to ~10 engineers. Reports directly to the CEO.
bullets: Built an end-to-end Whisper fine-tuning platform — audio preprocessing (VAD via pyannote/Silero/Kaldi, Demucs separation, segment-level deduplication, augmentation, QC gates) through distributed training, checkpoint export and cloud sync.

Productionized multi-GPU training on DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 across 4-GPU nodes; diagnosed and fixed NCCL collective failures, torchrun TCPStore rendezvous hangs, per-rank CUDA device binding, and multi-GPU finalize deadlocks on GCP Blackwell instances.
Orchestrated preprocessing and training with Prefect and MLflow; added GCS autoresume, hardware-aware GPU/CPU launch, and pre-training readiness checks — enabling unattended multi-day runs.
Split a monolithic training repository into two stage-modular services, each with its own orchestration and tracking.

Built the AutoDub speech pipeline — STT, regional TTS, voice cloning and accent conversion — and merged it into the main dubbing application with user workspaces, projects, and a MySQL-to-PostgreSQL consolidation plan.
Cut the dubbing editor's page load from 4,523 MB to 38 MB transferred (118x) through promise caching, Opus previews, lazy waveform rendering, and a canvas-dimension fix.
Ran the production Google Drive to S3 migration, including IAM design, S3 access points and multi-worker transfer tooling.
Built and maintained 20+ WordPress sites including the Communities Foundation of Texas (CFT) and CCRSM projects; implemented WooCommerce flows, site migrations and performance optimization.
Built responsive React interfaces to pixel-perfect designs within a function-based architecture.
